text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...The time has finally come. 
Today, I will not lose!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Because everyone back home in Hidaka 
gave me 
so many encouraging and supportive words."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It has always been this way. 
I have carried an overflowing amount of 
love 
from everyone to reach this point."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"That is why, today of all days... 
I will live up to everyone's 
expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Please watch over me as well, Tore-san. 
With my running, I will prove to the world 
just how wonderful my hometown truly 
is...!"
